summary: Diagnosed the previous matrix run as invalid construction rather than evidence: with ordered config changes enabled, a change is up to date only when its ConfigChangeId equals the membership's current id, which starts at zero and becomes the accepted entry index, so the harness's 1..13 values made every case read as out of order. Submitted a successor experiment whose harness tracks the last accepted index and supplies it as each change's ConfigChangeId, emitting case name, acceptance, supplied ccid and entry index for the same thirteen-case sequence. The earlier receipt remains in history and is not used as evidence; a fresh execution is requested.
